caption:
Mango Chia Seed Pudding 
C: 19 | F: 13 | P: 8
Calories: 217 per serve
Makes 2 serves

Ingredients:
1/4 cup chia seeds
1 1/4 cup milk, i used lactose free, you can use almond, coconut, oats, soyor regular whole milk, basically whatever you want 
2 sachets monk fruit sweetener
2 - 3 mangoes, peeled and cubed

Ingredients:
mix together the chia, milk and monkfruit in a bowl and leave in the fridge overnight
the next morning, layer with fresh mango and serve :)
i like using frozen mango cubes as i feel it adds texture and i love frozen mango in general
